info.name: Marlink PRA API v2.0.1
info.description:
This Postman collection provides a comprehensive set of API endpoints for managing and interacting with the PRA (Privileged Remote Access) Portal. It includes endpoints for health monitoring, customer management, site management, user management, jumpoint management, and more. Each endpoint is documented with request methods, headers, parameters, and example responses to facilitate easy integration and testing.

Base URL: `https://pra-api-pp.cdn-vas.net`

Make sure to replace placeholder variables (e.g., `{{accessKey}}`, `{{customerId}}`) with actual values before making requests.

item.name: Sites
item.description: Endpoints for managing sites within the PRA Portal.

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of sites with filtering capabilities. Access is automatically scoped to the authenticated user's customer permissions. Sites represent physical or logical locations where customer infrastructure is deployed.

response.name: 400 Bad Request

request.description: Creates a new site and assigns initial management roles. The site key must be unique and the customer must exist. Site managers, administrators, and support team members can be assigned during creation.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Validation Error

request.description: Permanently deletes a site from the system. The site must not have any active jumpoints or other dependencies, otherwise the operation may fail.
Retrieves site managers for the specified site. Site managers have administrative privileges for the site and can manage site operations.
Assigns a user as a site manager for the specified site. The user must exist and have appropriate permissions.
Removes a user from the site manager role for the specified site. The user will no longer have site management privileges.
Retrieves site administrators for the specified site. Site administrators have administrative privileges for site configuration and management.
Assigns a user as a site administrator for the specified site. The user must exist and have appropriate permissions.
Removes a user from the site administrator role for the specified site. The user will no longer have site administration privileges.
Retrieves support team members for the specified site. Support team members provide technical assistance and maintenance for site operations.
Assigns a user as a support team member for the specified site. The user must exist and have appropriate technical permissions.
Removes a user from the support team member role for the specified site. The user will no longer have support access privileges.

response.name: 204 No Content - Support Team Member Removed

request.description: Retrieves all jumpoints associated with the specified site. Jumpoints are secure remote access endpoints deployed at the site location.

item.name: Jumpoints
item.description: Endpoints for managing jumpoints within the PRA Portal.

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all jumpoints configured in the system. Jumpoints are remote access endpoints that facilitate secure connections.
Retrieves detailed information about a specific jumpoint by its unique identifier.
Creates a new jumpoint with the specified configuration. The jumpoint must be associated with an existing site.
Updates the configuration of an existing jumpoint. Only the specified fields will be modified.
Permanently deletes a jumpoint from the system. This action cannot be undone.
Retrieves the list of nodes associated with the specified jumpoint.
Downloads the installer package for a specific jumpoint, enabling deployment on target systems.
